text:
Your biggest enemy isn't lack of knowledge. It's lack of readiness.

The formula for getting what you want is sitting right in front of you. You've probably heard it a dozen times.

But your mind skipped right over it. Because you weren't ready.

You can't force it. You can't fake it. You can't pay for it.

You have to BUILD the mind that sees it.

Do the work. Kill the distractions. Get sharp.

The answer was never hiding from you. You were hiding from it.
caption:
Discipline and mindset are what separate men who win from men who stay stuck. The answer was never the problem — your readiness was.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
